about_the_game:
Your Definitive Text Toolkit

Cool Text is the ultimate Swiss Army Knife for anyone who works with text. It combines a powerful text transformer, a flexible random generator, and a classic encryption suite into one streamlined application. Whether you're spicing up a message, creating secure passwords, or automating workflows, Cool Text provides the tools you need.

Designed for efficiency and creativity, it's the essential utility for developers, content creators, and anyone looking to master their text.

Key Features

  • Powerful Transformation Engine: Apply dozens of effects in any combination, from simple case changes and text mirroring to 1337 speak, keyboard layout correction, and advanced text replacement.

  • Advanced Random Generator: Create secure passwords and random strings with precise control over character sets, length, uniqueness, and coefficient weighting.

  • Classic Encryption Suite: Encode and decode messages using classic ciphers like Caesar and Morse, or convert text to standard ASCII/Unicode values for technical tasks.

  • Save Everything in Profiles: Don't repeat yourself. Save any combination of settings from any section as a reusable profile for instant access. You can share profiles with other users!

  • Powerful Scripting Engine: Automate complex, multi-step text operations by chaining your saved profiles together. Transform, generate, and process text in sequence with a single click.

  • Seamless System Tray Integration: Access all your saved profiles and scripts directly from the system tray without even opening the main window, boosting your workflow speed.

  • Full UI Customization: Make the app truly yours. Choose between light and dark themes, or create, import, and export your own unique visual styles.
